activity_summary: At two the plot was Titus at the Theatre. No name of a part was on the peg. You did not add one. The hired men had the name by this afternoon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, and brought no part-name away.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: The name is his, from last night. He is not on this plot.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: They had the name by this afternoon.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Mentioned in Titus, no name of a part
